v1Tools.name: activity
v1Tools.mapsTo: the shell's presence roster (online); GET /api/social/search or /api/social/plane/search?q=&type=huddle|calllog|message|pin&limit= (calls, messages, pins); GET /api/search?q=&type=work&sort=recent (work)

v1Tools.name: message
v1Tools.mapsTo: GET /api/social/resolve?kind=&name= (P6, a read), then on confirm POST /api/social/dms { userId } for a person (G14) and useChat(channel).sendMessage(text, { displayName, clientDeliveryId }) over the gateway; a thread reply (G23) goes to the inbound message\'s own channel with metadata.replyTo, no resolve; attach (G24): GET /api/roster/users?userIds= for a person, then on confirm POST /api/social/plane/work-sharing { audience: { kind: conversation, id }, nodeIds, disclosure: summary, durationMs } and the post carries metadata.pageReference { kind, id }

v1Tools.name: call
v1Tools.mapsTo: GET /api/social/resolve?kind=&name= (P6), then the shell's call host: useSocialCall().callConversation({ channel, title }) for a team or channel, callPeople([{ userId, displayName }]) for a person after POST /api/social/dms { userId } on confirm (G14); join: GET /api/social/search or GET /api/social/plane/search?type=huddle (the live huddles the index shows), then callConversation on that conversation's lobby, which walks into its live call

v1Tools.name: set_status
v1Tools.mapsTo: usePresence('<tenant>:lobby') (the shell's tenant lobby, manifest presenceLobby) then usePresence('social:lobby') with a Social grant: setStatus(status) and updateMetadata({ statusMessage })

v1Tools.name: queue_work
v1Tools.mapsTo: sweep: POST /api/work/sweeps/run { sweep?, background: true } then GET /api/work/sweeps/jobs/:id; bot-run: GET /api/bots, POST /api/bots/:id/run, GET /api/bots/:id/runs; pipeline: GET /api/pipelines/runbooks, POST /api/pipelines/definitions/:id/dry-run, GET /api/pipelines/runs/:id; job: GET /api/work/suggestions, POST /api/work/jobs, GET /api/work/jobs/:id; dispatch: GET /api/graph/work, GET /api/bots/estimate, POST /api/bots/dispatch-work; finding-promote and finding-analyze: GET /api/work/findings, POST /api/work/findings/:id/promote, POST /api/work/findings/:id/analyze; change-rereview and change-address: GET /api/sdlc/changes, POST /api/sdlc/changes/:id/rereview, POST /api/sdlc/changes/:id/address, GET /api/sdlc/changes/:id; deck: GET /api/graph/projects, POST /api/initiative-decks/projects/:projectId, GET /api/assessment/teams, POST /api/assessment/teams/:teamId/decks, GET /api/assessment/runs/:runId, GET /api/pipelines/runs, POST /api/pipelines/runs/:id/decks, GET /api/social/resolve, POST /api/chat/commands/deck/run, GET /api/chat/commands/deck/runs/:id; summarize, diagram and doc: POST /api/conversations/summarize/run, POST /api/conversations/diagram/run, POST /api/conversations/doc/run, GET /api/conversations/summarize/runs/:id, GET /api/conversations/diagram/runs/:id, GET /api/conversations/doc/runs/:id, POST /api/chat/commands/summarize/run, POST /api/chat/commands/diagram/run, POST /api/chat/commands/doc/run, GET /api/chat/commands/summarize/runs/:id, GET /api/chat/commands/diagram/runs/:id, GET /api/chat/commands/doc/runs/:id; assessment-run: POST /api/assessment/runs; drafts: GET /api/assessment/teams/:id, POST /api/assessment/teams/:id/dimensions/:dim/drafts/evidence-summary, POST /api/assessment/teams/:id/dimensions/:dim/drafts/followups, GET /api/assessment/drafts/:runId; each woken by GET /api/work/events (Work) or GET /api/pipelines/runs/:id/events

v1Tools.name: decide
v1Tools.mapsTo: access: GET /api/access/approvals, POST /api/access/requests/:id/steps/:step/decide { decision, comment }; GET /api/access/reviews/:id, POST /api/access/reviews/:id/items/:itemId/decide { decision: keep | revoke, comment }; pipelines: GET /api/pipelines/approvals, POST /api/pipelines/approvals/:id/decide { decision, note }; HITL: GET /api/observability/approvals, POST /api/observability/approvals/:id/decision { decision: APPROVED | REJECTED, note }; changes: GET /api/sdlc/changes/:id, POST /api/sdlc/changes/:id/decide { decision, note }, POST /api/sdlc/changes/:id/deliver; runbook proposals: GET /api/runbooks/proposals/:pid, POST /api/runbooks/proposals/:pid/accept { expected_version, note }, POST /api/runbooks/proposals/:pid/reject { note }; graph proposals: GET /api/work/proposals, POST /api/work/proposals/:id/decide { decision, note }; consults: GET /api/lab/consults, POST /api/lab/consults/:id/answer { answer }; designs: GET /api/designs/:id, POST /api/designs/:id/signoff { decision }; decisions: GET /api/graph/decisions/:id, POST /api/graph/decisions/:id/decide { optionId?, outcome: resolved | rejected, rationale }; drafts: GET /api/assessment/drafts/:runId, POST /api/assessment/drafts/:runId/accept, POST /api/assessment/drafts/:runId/discard

v1Tools.name: create
v1Tools.mapsTo: work-item: GET /api/graph/projects (or the initiative in view), POST /api/graph/work-items { projectId, type, title, priority }; document and whiteboard: GET /api/graph/projects/:projectId/workspace-documents (canWrite), POST /api/graph/projects/:projectId/workspace-documents { title, kind: page | whiteboard }, then the editor opens; deck: as queue_work's deck, POST /api/initiative-decks/projects/:projectId { narrative, brief }; comment: GET /api/graph/work, POST /api/graph/work-items/:id/comments { body }; saved-search: POST /api/saved-searches { name, query, scope }; sprint: POST /api/sprints { initiativeId, name, startsOn, endsOn }; channel, team, room: POST /api/social/channels, POST /api/social/teams, POST /api/social/rooms; access-request: GET /api/access/catalog, POST /api/access/requests/preview, POST /api/access/requests { itemId, justification, duration }; delegation: GET /api/access/delegates, POST /api/access/delegations { delegateId, startsAt, endsAt, reason }

v1Tools.name: update
v1Tools.mapsTo: work-item: GET /api/graph/work, PATCH /api/graph/work-items/:id { status | assigneeId } (the owner from GET /api/graph/projects/:id contributors), GET /api/sprints, PATCH /api/sprints/:sprintId/items { workItemId }, DELETE /api/sprints/:sprintId/items/:itemId; bot: GET /api/bots, POST /api/bots/:id/pause, POST /api/bots/:id/resume; finding: GET /api/work/findings, POST /api/work/findings/:id/dismiss; job: GET /api/work/jobs, POST /api/work/jobs/:id/review { decision }, POST /api/work/jobs/:id/requeue; channel: GET /api/social/channels, POST /api/social/channels/:slug/join, POST /api/social/channels/:slug/leave, GET /api/social/plane/channels, POST /api/social/plane/channels/:slug/join, POST /api/social/plane/channels/:slug/leave; dm: GET /api/social/dms, GET /api/social/plane/dms, POST /api/social/dms/read { channel }; run: GET /api/assessment/runs, POST /api/assessment/runs/:runId/stop, GET /api/pipelines/runs, POST /api/pipelines/runs/:id/cancel; feedback: GET /api/assessment/feedback, POST /api/assessment/feedback/:taskId/resolve { response }, POST /api/assessment/feedback/:taskId/dismiss; report: POST /api/assessment/reports/publish; request: GET /api/access/requests, POST /api/access/requests/:id/withdraw; delegation: GET /api/access/delegations, POST /api/access/delegations/:id/end

v1Tools.name: access_request_status
v1Tools.mapsTo: GET /api/access-requests/mine (outside the access tenant); inside it GET /api/access/requests?scope=mine|reports&q= or GET /api/access/approvals

v2Tools.name: search
v2Tools.description: Free-text search over a tenant index (people, records, questions), with scope, type, sort and limit; replaces search_people and search_records.

v2Tools.name: open
v2Tools.description: Open a page by id, a kept result row by ref, or a record by typed ref (initiative, computer, request, run); replaces navigate, open_result and open_computer_lab.

v2Tools.name: list
v2Tools.description: A typed collection read with filters (initiatives, computers, machines, channels, teams, DMs, requests, approvals, runs, definitions, queues, artifacts, submissions, feedback, runbooks, proposals, bots, decks, documents, budgets, sprints, decisions, work items, findings, jobs); replaces list_active_initiatives.

v2Tools.name: get
v2Tools.description: One record by ref: its detail, status, steps, members or history.

v2Tools.name: summary
v2Tools.description: An aggregate since a time: sweeps and bot runs, pipeline runs, the work queue, ingest jobs, the fleet, assessment rollup, access summary, health; replaces bot_sweep_status.

v2Tools.name: activity
v2Tools.description: Who is online, live and missed calls, messages, pins, what a person worked on, everything recent (as today).

v2Tools.name: budget
v2Tools.description: Spend and allocation reads at the budgets read tier: my spend, an initiative, the org, a user, the cost aggregates.

v2Tools.name: message
v2Tools.description: Post a dictated message to a team, channel or person (as send_chat_message).

v2Tools.name: set_status
v2Tools.description: Set the caller's own presence and status message (as today).

v2Tools.name: call
v2Tools.description: Start a huddle or ring a person; join a live huddle the caller may see (start_call plus join).

v2Tools.name: computer
v2Tools.description: action: start | stop | open-shell | run (safe-mode phrase) | hand-work (to a paired machine); merges start_computer, open_shell, run_command; open-shell does not confirm.

v2Tools.name: queue_work
v2Tools.description: Queue background work and follow it with one toast: a sweep, a bot run, a pipeline dry-run, a work job, an assessment agent run or draft, a conversation command (summarize, deck, diagram, doc, agent plan), a deck revision (G19 generalised).

v2Tools.name: decide
v2Tools.description: Decide something waiting on the caller: an access step, a pipeline step, a HITL approval, an agent change, a runbook or work proposal, an agent-loop plan, an exception, a document proposal, a review item, a design question.

v2Tools.name: create
v2Tools.description: Create a record of a kind: access request, work item, comment or discussion post, saved search, sprint, channel, team, room, delegation, document proposal, review request.

v2Tools.name: update
v2Tools.description: A small state change on a record the caller may edit: work item fields, pin or unpin, join or leave a channel, mark a DM read, withdraw a request, dismiss or resolve, pause or resume a bot, cancel a run, mark a job reviewed or requeued, publish a report, team membership of self, sprint items.

the exchange between the meeting assistant and the asking person's own browser: the server lists the tool calls made for that person, lets one browser claim a turn before running it, and takes the result that browser ran (never anyone else's); it is the transport of a tool call, not a tool of its own
